description: This file is a Java source file defining the TestingUtils class, which provides various utility methods for testing engine charts, waveforms, and related components in the project. It includes assertion methods, chart data retrieval, and interaction with external components like LinkManager and FileLog.

classes.name: TestingUtils
classes.description: A utility class providing methods to facilitate testing and validation of engine chart data, waveforms, and hardware interaction in the project.

methods.name: assertTrue
methods.description: Asserts that a given boolean condition is true, throwing an exception if not.

methods.name: assertCloseEnough
methods.description: Checks if a current value is within an acceptable ratio of expected values, used for verifying engine parameters.

methods.name: fail
methods.description: Logs a failure message and throws an IllegalStateException to indicate test failure.

methods.name: assertWave
methods.description: Asserts that a waveform in an engine chart matches expected parameters.

methods.name: assertWaveFall
methods.description: Asserts waveform behavior with a fall pattern in the engine chart.

methods.name: assertWave
methods.description: Overloaded method to assert waveform with detailed parameters including rise or fall, width, and angle tolerances.

methods.name: getNextWaveChart
methods.description: Triggers retrieval of the next engine chart data from the external system.

methods.name: getEngineChart
methods.description: Blocks and waits for the next engine chart data from the I/O pipeline, with a timeout.
